@[irreducible] def Aeneas.Std.loop.{u, v} : {α : Type u} →
  {β : Type v} → (α → Aeneas.Std.Result (Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow α β)) → α → Aeneas.Std.Result β :=
fun {α} {β} body =>
  Lean.Order.fix
    (fun f x =>
      match body x with
      | Aeneas.Std.Result.ok r =>
        match r with
        | Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.cont x => f x
        | Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.done x => Aeneas.Std.Result.ok x
      | Aeneas.Std.Result.fail e => Aeneas.Std.Result.fail e
      | Aeneas.Std.Result.div => Aeneas.Std.Result.div)
    ⋯
inductive Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.{u, v} : Type u → Type v → Type (max u v)

theorem Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def.{u, v} : ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v}
  (body : α → Aeneas.Std.Result (Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow α β)) (x : α),
  Aeneas.Std.loop body x =
    match body x with
    | Aeneas.Std.Result.ok r =>
      match r with
      | Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.cont x => Aeneas.Std.loop body x
      | Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.done x => Aeneas.Std.Result.ok x
    | Aeneas.Std.Result.fail e => Aeneas.Std.Result.fail e
    | Aeneas.Std.Result.div => Aeneas.Std.Result.div :=
fun {α} {β} body x =>
  id
    (Eq.trans (congrFun (Lean.Order.fix_eq (Aeneas.Std.loop._proof_1 body)) x)
      (Eq.refl
        (match body x with
        | Aeneas.Std.Result.ok r =>
          match r with
          | Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.cont x =>
            Lean.Order.fix
              (fun f x =>
                match body x with
                | Aeneas.Std.Result.ok r =>
                  match r with
                  | Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.cont x => f x
                  | Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.done x => Aeneas.Std.Result.ok x
                | Aeneas.Std.Result.fail e => Aeneas.Std.Result.fail e
                | Aeneas.Std.Result.div => Aeneas.Std.Result.div)
              (Aeneas.Std.loop._proof_1 body) x
          | Aeneas.Std.ControlFlow.done x => Aeneas.Std.Result.ok x
        | Aeneas.Std.Result.fail e => Aeneas.Std.Result.fail e
        | Aeneas.Std.Result.div => Aeneas.Std.Result.div)))
